corrections.text: The article describes Trew as "an automated material handling systems manufacturer" and attributes that description to The Robot Report. The Robot Report source names only "Trew Automation" without that descriptor. The descriptor is accurate and is drawn from the American Industrial Partners release, which calls Trew "a U.S.-based manufacturer and integrator of automated material handling systems and software," and from DC Velocity, which calls it "the automated material handling solutions provider." The attribution, not the fact, is being corrected.
